summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for Balancer V2 Vault.

findings.title: Transient Balance Tracking & Reentrancy Guard in Pool Joins
findings.description: Vault holds all token balances for arbitrary pools; reentrancy guard must span join/exit/swap operations across differing tokens.

attackSurface.attackVector: Pool hook malicious callback attempting to manipulate vault token accounting before flash loan settlement.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
